tasks.spec:
You are a code-feature worker implementing Phase 11 (cloud sync) of MonetaFox Reborn, a local-first Microsoft Money replacement PWA at /home/user/Source/MonetaFoxReborn (the REPO). Read plan-reborn.md (Phase 11) and spec.md (Data Storage & Sync) first. Reuse (do NOT reimplement): src/lib/export/ (exportEncrypted(data, passphrase) → portable ciphertext string, importEncrypted(blob, passphrase) → data, and the BackupData shape), src/lib/crypto/, the stores (useAuthStore for the in-memory session; initializeStores in stores/index.ts), src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx (already has delete-account + currency + data-export sections — ADD a sync section, keep the rest).

DESIGN (per spec): exactly ONE active cloud destination at a time (Google Drive OR OneDrive), behind a storage-provider INTERFACE built so future backends (S3/Dropbox) slot in. Sync payloads are ENCRYPTED ONLY — never upload plaintext. Triggers: manual, scheduled, and on data change. Because real OAuth cannot run in this sandbox, the deterministic core (interface + encrypted round-trip) uses an in-memory provider; the Drive/OneDrive providers are real REST implementations that receive an access token via an injected getter (the OAuth acquisition is a browser-only seam).

CONVENTIONS (pinned by a hidden contract test): syncUp encrypts the store via exportEncrypted and uploads the ciphertext; the stored blob must NOT contain plaintext (e.g. a payee). syncDown downloads, importEncrypts, and returns the identical store; a WRONG passphrase must REJECT; downloading when nothing is stored returns null. Providers are resolved from a registry by id.

BOUNDARY / OWNERSHIP: Edit directly in the REPO working tree. You OWN only: src/lib/sync/** (create), src/stores/syncStore.ts (create), src/stores/index.ts (register syncStore in initializeStores/resetStores + export it — do NOT change other stores), src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx (add a sync section only), and new src/components/sync/** files. Do NOT modify src/lib/export/**, src/lib/crypto/**, auth/db, the other stores/pages, routes.tsx, Layout.tsx, App.tsx, the .md files, or .ringer/. Do NOT add dependencies (implement Drive/OneDrive with fetch + a bearer token; do NOT reimplement crypto — reuse export). Do NOT git commit or push.

DELIVERABLE — implement with this EXACT public API (a hidden contract test pins it):
1. src/lib/sync/index.ts (re-export everything below):
   - export interface CloudStorageProvider { id: string; label: string; upload(key: string, contents: string): Promise<void>; download(key: string): Promise<string | null> }
   - export class MemoryProvider implements CloudStorageProvider { id = 'memory'; ... } — an in-memory Map-backed provider (for local/tests).
   - export function registerCloudProvider(p: CloudStorageProvider): void; export function getCloudProvider(id: string): CloudStorageProvider | undefined; export function listCloudProviders(): string[].
   - export async function syncUp(provider: CloudStorageProvider, data: BackupData, passphrase: string, key?: string): Promise<{ key: string; bytes: number }> — exportEncrypted(data, passphrase) then provider.upload(key, blob); default key e.g. 'monetafox/backup.enc'.
   - export async function syncDown(provider: CloudStorageProvider, passphrase: string, key?: string): Promise<BackupData | null> — provider.download(key); null if absent; else importEncrypted(blob, passphrase).
   - export a GoogleDriveProvider and a OneDriveProvider implementing CloudStorageProvider via the respective REST upload/download endpoints, each constructed with a getAccessToken: () => Promise<string> injected by the UI (the OAuth flow itself is wired in the UI, not here).
2. src/stores/syncStore.ts — Zustand store: initialize(repos); state for the active provider id, connection/auth status, lastSyncAt, sync status ('idle'|'syncing'|'error'), and trigger settings (manual | scheduled interval | on-change); actions connect(providerId, tokenGetter), uploadNow(), downloadNow(), fullSync(), and a way to serialize the current stores into BackupData and to apply a downloaded BackupData back via the repositories (then refresh stores). Register in src/stores/index.ts.
3. src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx — add a Cloud Sync section: choose the ONE active destination (Google Drive or OneDrive), Connect (invokes the provider's OAuth token getter — a best-effort browser flow), manual Upload / Download / Full Sync buttons, a connection + last-sync status indicator, and trigger settings (manual/scheduled/on-change). Keep the existing Settings sections.

HOW TO VERIFY before finishing (from REPO root), running each ONCE: `corepack pnpm run typecheck`, `corepack pnpm run test`, `corepack pnpm run lint` — all exit 0. (Do NOT loop the suite. `pnpm run build` is verified by CI; you may run it once if you like but the graded check does not.) Write real Vitest tests for the sync round-trip (MemoryProvider) and the registry.

OUTPUT CONTRACT: make the changes in owned paths, then write ./notes.md in your task dir: what you read, files created/changed, commands run with results, the provider interface + registry, the encrypted round-trip, how the Drive/OneDrive token seam works, the trigger design, and any follow-up (incl. that live OAuth is browser-tested only).

HARD RULES: match the API signatures exactly; upload ONLY ciphertext (reuse exportEncrypted); one active destination; keep OAuth/network inside the providers/UI; reuse export/crypto (no new deps); keep it typed and boring; keep the suite deterministic; do not touch files outside ownership; do not commit.
tasks.verified: A hidden contract test passes (syncUp stores ciphertext with no plaintext; syncDown restores an identical store; wrong passphrase rejects; empty destination returns null; the provider registry registers/resolves/lists). The sync module (interface, MemoryProvider, registry, syncUp/syncDown, Google Drive + OneDrive providers), a syncStore registered in initializeStores, and a SettingsPage sync section with manual controls all exist. The Phase 7b/3a/1 contract tests still pass; typecheck + suite + lint pass (build in CI). Only owned paths changed; nothing committed.
